desc: Establish the elementary-support formulation: optimum is the minimum of a branching-tree support cost \(2|E|\) and a unicyclic support cost \(2|E|-|C|\), with path-only graphs impossible.
Implement and exhaustively validate the exact tree solver using the corrected two-case branch formula, including a constructive proof of each cost case.
Derive and prove the complete block-cut-tree global optimization, including route-block connector costs, off-route cycle behavior, and feasibility conditions.
Verify/prove the distinct-portal block subproblem and its total near-linear complexity.
Implement the actual stdin-to-stdout solver with an iterative stack-safe decomposition suitable for \(N,M\le2\times10^5\).
Validate the revised general-graph solver against exhaustive small graphs, samples, and adversarial graph families.
